notes.title: RELEASE DATE CONFIRMED: SEPTEMBER 22, 2025
notes.notes:
Attention, Dreamers! 

We're thrilled to announce that HYPERxFANTASY officially launches September 22, 2025:     [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/embed/_dDpvnWXJKg"][/dynamiclink]  

As you may have figured out, the main creator Surcutt-P got imprisoned inside HYPERxFANTASY by a character he created - the overpowered overlord named the Arch-Executer. So prepare on Monday to help him, or he'll be stuck there forever!



Here's a sneak peek at what you'll do while helping Surcutt-P:



Find Your Adept
Choose a candidate for Ascension. Otherwise they'll take Yui. You wouldn't want that.



Navigate the Humanity Expo 

From Execution Chambers to Critter Village. Each location holds secrets that may be better not to tell the Arch-Executor about... Or you can tell her and see for yourself...



Complete Wish Contracts

Fulfill the final wishes of Spherius and Teé. Your choices determine who ascends... and who departs.



Manage Your Companions 

Yui and Enris will keep you company, along with the little floating tyrant named Todd (attached to your chest, he looks like a machine-toddler). But maybe they have their own agendas - be careful.



Remember - it all starts Monday, September 22, 2025.

Wishlist the game if you haven't already. It helps a lot.



See you in HYPERxFANTASY!
